entities.name: PMID:25085604
observations: Duke et al., European Journal of Applied Physiology (2014), tested maximal running, drop-position cycling, and upright cycling in 18 men.

entities.name: OLV vary by exercise mode
observations: In 18 men, end-inspiratory and end-expiratory lung volumes were larger during drop cycling than running; end-inspiratory volume was larger during upright cycling than running. Operating lung volumes did not differ between drop and upright cycling, suggesting trunk/hip angle was not the primary determinant under tested maximal-exercise conditions.
